paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 1.66 as of 2026-11-09, representing a 5.41 percent increase from the prior close, but a 51.75 percent decrease over the last 22 trading sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Recent news includes a headline from Stocktwits that the largest shareholder of Fermi Inc has renewed a push for an immediate sale after an 80 percent rout, with the co-founder and largest shareholder Toby Neugebauer having made this call last week.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including a Form 4 filed on 2026-11-06, and multiple Form 144 filings on 2026-11-05, 2026-11-04, and 2026-11-03, which are notices of proposed sales of restricted shares by insiders, as well as a Form 8-K filing on 2026-11-04 disclosing the results of the company's 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders.
